desc: The Silver Rifled Deer shotgun is time-proven, efficient, sleek and designed with the purpose of knocking whitetail deer flat. The rifled barrel has a 3" chamber and is designed with thick walls to handle high pressure from slug cartridges. The cantilever mount will accommodate a scope, red dot, or reflex sight for fast acquisition and accurate fire. The cantilever mount also allows you to attach a scope to the barrel so you can keep your zero when cleaning the shotgun or swapping out barrels for hunting birds or even busting clays.
